title: Heat and Temperature
summary: Temperature measures how hot something is; heat is energy that flows from hotter to colder objects.

ib.note: Specific heat capacity follows in MYP 4–5

cbse.chapter: Curiosity Ch 7: Temperature and its Measurement
Curiosity Ch 7: Heat Transfer in Nature

objectives: I can distinguish between heat (energy transferred) and temperature (how hot something is).
I can explain that heat flows from a hotter object to a colder one until they reach the same temperature.
I can predict the final temperature when hot and cold water are mixed.
misconceptions: Heat and temperature are the same thing.
Cold flows into warm objects (it's heat that flows out).
